import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Define grid for subplots
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Top left: Revenue by product category (bar chart)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax1.bar(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values, color=sns.color_palette('husl', len(product_revenue)))
ax1.set_title('Total Revenue by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + max(product_revenue.values)*0.01,
             f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# 2. Top middle: Sales distribution by time of day (heatmap style)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
hours = list(range(24))
hourly_values = [hourly_sales.get(h, 0) for h in hours]
colors = plt.cm.YlOrRd((np.array(hourly_values) - min(hourly_values)) / (max(hourly_values) - min(hourly_values)))
bars2 = ax2.bar(hours, hourly_values, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_title('Revenue by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax2.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
ax2.set_xlim(-0.5, 23.5)

# 3. Top right: Payment method distribution (pie chart)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(payment_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Middle left: Customer age group analysis (grouped bar chart)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
age_takeaway = pd.crosstab(df['customer_age_group'], df['is_takeaway'])
age_takeaway.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
age_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#2E86AB', '#A23B72'])
ax4.set_title('Sales by Age Group & Takeaway Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
ax4.legend(title='Service Type')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 5. Middle: Size distribution across products (stacked bar chart)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
size_product = pd.crosstab(df['product'], df['size'])
size_product = size_product.reindex(columns=['Small', 'Medium', 'Large'])
colors_size = ['#FF9F1C', '#2EC4B6', '#E71D36']
size_product.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax5, color=colors_size)
ax5.set_title('Product Size Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Product')
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
ax5.legend(title='Size')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Middle right: Average transaction value by age group (bar chart with error bars)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
age_stats = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].agg(['mean', 'std', 'count'])
age_stats = age_stats.sort_values('mean', ascending=False)
bars6 = ax6.bar(age_stats.index, age_stats['mean'], 
                yerr=age_stats['std'], capsize=5, color=sns.color_palette('viridis', len(age_stats)))
ax6.set_title('Average Transaction Value by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(age_stats.iterrows()):
    ax6.text(i, row['mean'] + row['std'] + 0.5, f'${row["mean"]:.2f}', 
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 7. Bottom: Time series of daily revenue (line chart)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])
daily_revenue = df.groupby(df['datetime'].dt.date)['total'].sum()
ax7.plot(daily_revenue.index, daily_revenue.values, marker='o', markersize=3, 
         linewidth=2, color='#2E86AB', alpha=0.7)
ax7.fill_between(daily_revenue.index, daily_revenue.values, alpha=0.2, color='#2E86AB')
ax7.set_title('Daily Revenue Trend', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Date')
ax7.set_ylabel('Daily Revenue ($)')
ax7.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
